$comment: Lane micro: no file under web/, extension/, supabase/ or .actio/bin/, and no package*.json: docs, agent definitions, skills, config. No product code (design-v2 section 4, actio-orchestration Lanes). The maker defaults to tech-architect with design-authority; when the surface is another role's (strings: ux-writer and copy), swap the agent, its gate, and the gate name in the blocked_by lists. security-analyst stays only when .claude/settings.json, .mcp.json, an agent's tools: line, permissions, hooks or secrets are touched; otherwise delete its entry, the security gate, security from release-engineer's blocked_by and security-analyst/handoff.json from its consumes, and record it in out_of_scope.
lane_reason: <orchestrator: why this lane, from the files the change touches>
out_of_scope: ux-designer, ux-auditor: lane micro, no product surface to design or audit
ux-writer: lane micro, no product string changes (swap it in as the maker if one does)
frontend-engineer, backend-engineer: lane micro, nothing under web/, extension/ or supabase/
code-analyst, code-steward: lane micro, no code; peer-reviewer judges the doctrine
engineering-lead: lane micro, nothing to build, migrate or integrate
qc-engineer, qc-lead: lane micro, no product behaviour to test
gate design: its owner ux-auditor is not in the micro plan
gate copy: its owner ux-writer is not in the micro plan
gate review-2of3: its owner code-analyst is not in the micro plan
gate review-3of3: its owner code-steward is not in the micro plan
gate engineering: its owner engineering-lead is not in the micro plan
gate quality: its owner qc-lead is not in the micro plan

plan.task: Regression brief: node .actio/bin/bugs.mjs brief for this run's surfaces, then judgement lines for patterns the tag maps missed. One slice per agent in the plan.
<orchestrator: the maker's task, the files it edits, and the maker role if not tech-architect> Make the change and certify its gate.
accept: No file under web/, extension/, supabase/ or .actio/bin/ and no package*.json changes, or the run moves to another lane

plan.task: Doctrine review of the maker's change at the latest snapshot: does it say what the brief asks, contradict no other agent, skill or rule, and leave no stale reference behind.
Security sweep of the configuration change at the latest snapshot: permissions, hooks, MCP servers, tools lines, secrets in tree and history. Delete this entry when no such file is touched.
Regression guard: node .actio/bin/bugs.mjs guard for this run on the maker's snapshot. Runs beside the reviews, not after them; re-run on each new snapshot.
Release: pre-flight, commit, tag and push to origin main, verify. Migrations n/a (no supabase/ change); hosting recorded as deferred: no target chosen.
Record pass: every product-code defect from this run into BUGS.md with its standing rule; ids from bugs.mjs next-id, the Open index from bugs.mjs open-index.
